Zycubo (copper histidinate) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-589221  
Guideline Name 
Zycubo (copper histidinate)  
Formulary 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
5/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Zycubo  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) confirming BOTH of the following:  
 
 1.1 Diagnosis of Menkes disease  


=== PDF PAGE 2129 ===
Page 2129 
 
AND 
 
 1.2 Molecular genetic testing confirms pathogenic variants of the ATP7A gene (copper-
transporting ATPase) as detected by an FDA-approved test or a test performed at a facility 
approved by Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Provider attests that the patient will be closely monitored for copper accumulation and 
related toxicity throughout therapy  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with one of the following:  
Pediatrician  
Neurologist  
Geneticist  
 
Product Name:Zycubo  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient demonstrates positive clinical response to therapy  
 
AND 


=== PDF PAGE 2130 ===
Page 2130 
 
2 - Provider attests that the patient will continue to be monitored for copper accumulation and 
related toxicity throughout therapy  
 
AND 
 
3 - Patient has not exceeded 3 years duration of treatment with Zycubo  
 
AND 
 
4 - Prescribed by or in consultation with one of the following:  
Pediatrician  
Neurologist  
Geneticist
